notes.title: Update Notes for Sep 4, 2025
notes.content:
Fixed a crash that could happen often while playing adventure mode
	Added "Texture Quality" graphics option. Low RAM devices will automatically default to low or medium texture quality.
	Fixed some issues and crashes in the tortoise equipment screen
	Fixed some graphical issues with shadow map settings low and medium
	Other crash fixes

notes.title: Aug 6, 2025 - Hotfixes for the ui bugs, workaround for the terrain bug
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where parts of the ui would get cut off or hidden when anti-aliasing was enabled and resolution was anything other than the max setting
	Fixed an issue where textures would load totally wrong when running in windowed mode
	NOTE: the terrain still has a visual graphical glitch if you have shadows set to "off" or "low". To bypass the bug, change shadow setting to "medium" or above.

notes.title: May 28, 2024, v10014
notes.content:
May 28, 2024, v10014
	
	New War Supplies modifier: added an additional modifier to war supplies, based on the total number of war supplies equipped across all units and war tortoise; ie, the more war supplies you have equipped globally, the stronger the next war supply will be. This is a soft push to spread your war supplies around as many units/tortoise as you can, and will now give a significant boost to not horde war supplies on just your tortoise, or only a few units. This also adds an interesting wrinkle in the order you want to upgrade your units
	Players can now refresh daily fish/adventure/missions after an amount of time
	Fixed an issue with mouse clicks not registering while reeling in a fish
	Descriptions are now visible when viewing locked Evolutions
	Fixed some bugs in adventure mode
	Fixed a display bug with Ahap’s passive ability
	Each Ratling General and Toad Sergeant can summon at most 10 enemies at once
	Event rewards are now correctly affected by global fish bone multipliers (Navy tortoise, relics)
	Added an option to turn off confirmation prompts when spending gems
	Won’t auto aim in adventure mode past your weapon’s max range
	Added new airship merchant which will show up every few hours to sell individual items for gems
	Removed time to cook recipes; changed pack mouse ability to improve cooking strength instead of reduce cooking time
	Improved Next Generation mutation strength, and standardized the display level with normal mutations (so you can directly compare their strength); Next Generation mutations now have their strength modified by your regular mutations to make sure they are better balanced between each other

notes.title: May 14, 2024, v10013

notes.title: Update Notes - May 8, 2024, v10012
notes.content:
May 8, 2024, v10012
	
	Fixed an issue with Quick Spending on cheapest upgrades only buying war supplies for the player’s war tortoise
	Fixed a bug preventing adventure melee weapons not being able to hit flying units while jumping
	When auto moving to a location, locations that have been captured but are not on max level can now be chosen
	(PC) Greatly reduced the cost of fishing and adventure Relics
	When dying and auto continue is set, the game will no longer auto continue if the player manually presses Ascend
	When picking up refugees with auto battle activated, return home will automatically be selected after a time. Capped the number of refugee mice that can show at once.
	Fixed the Hero Power evolution displayed power

notes.title: Apr 12, 2024, v10007
notes.content:
Apr 12, 2024, v10007
https://www.foursakenmedia.com/changelog.php?game=wt_pc
	
	Make the boss banner window go away quicker when finishing lower level numbers (relative to your highest level for the current world)
	After auto next generation: fixed automatically choosing the next gen mutation, and chooses a location to travel to automatically
	If on auto battle level 4: auto choose a new location to go to after maxing it out
	Fixed a bug with Gun Tortoise’s ‘Explosive Shot’ evolution
	Pack Mouse’s ‘Collecting Gear’ evolution will now collect tortoise fruit after reaching level 2
	Heroes and pilots that are ready to level up will automatically level up after a time (without having to press the notification)
	Auto Battle should now stay consistently on when activated
	Fixed a bug allowing a destination boss to spawn on locked locations
	Increased the radius to mouse click on crates to collect
	Pack Mouse’s ‘Collecting Gear’ evolution will no longer collect boost crates that cost gems
	Added Lumber and DNA as potential rewards from event objectives
	Added a short cooldown for events to regenerate after completing
	Changed baby birth rate to 9 days, reduced from 9 months
	Add a save history in case save data is lost
	Improved threading prioritization on Windows (better performance)
